title: When You Ask for Supervisor, But Get a K9 Instead
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On February 3, 2024, a Columbia County Sheriff's deputy initiated a traffic stop on a vehicle due to an equipment violation in Fall River, WI. The male driver was uncooperative and hostile upon contact, with visible bags labeled as marijuana in his vehicle. When deputies tried to open his door, he fled the scene at high speed, resulting in a crash. K9 Rico was then unleashed and embraced the driver, offering a discomforting hug. Upon searching the vehicle, deputies discovered drug paraphernalia and large quantities of marijuana.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
